'''Fuzzum Squadron''' was a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in service of the [[Dimok government]]. During the late [[Sepan Civil War]], they joined forces with the [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attack]] the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forces, which were transferring new [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' to the [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']]. Despite their efforts, the squadron was defeated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
